{{ArticleBackground|File=SuperEpicMode.png}}

<h2> Overview </h2>

'''Super Epic MODE''' is a modifier that allows you to play the Original '''Rooms: Found Footage''' like it was during its April Fools 2024 event, it was a mode that added a lot of jokes entities as also made some things goofy, like D-60i or A-85i will make a spawn indicator sound be a [https://official-rooms-found-footage-renovated.fandom.com/wiki/File:BossIndicatorSEM.mp3 scream] instead, and they will play the Horror Race music. ''(for now the music and spawn indicator doesn't play)'', as long with the new [[Section UI|Section I]], that is a joke version of the [[Section I|Section Interchange]].
